WITH filtered_trans AS (
  SELECT 
    t.account_id,
    t.amount,
    t.balance,
    t.type,
    d.A3 as region
  FROM trans t
  INNER JOIN account a ON t.account_id = a.account_id
  INNER JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id
),
account_metrics AS (
  SELECT 
    account_id,
    region,
    AVG(CASE WHEN type IN ('PRIJEM', 'VYDAJ') THEN amount ELSE NULL END) as avg_amount,
    AVG(balance) as avg_balance
  FROM filtered_trans
  GROUP BY account_id, region
),
region_metrics AS (
  SELECT 
    region,
    AVG(avg_amount) as region_avg_amount,
    AVG(avg_balance) as region_avg_balance
  FROM account_metrics
  GROUP BY region
),
global_mean AS (
  SELECT AVG(region_avg_amount) as global_avg_amount
  FROM region_metrics
)
SELECT 
  r.region,
  r.region_avg_amount,
  r.region_avg_balance,
  r.region_avg_amount / g.global_avg_amount as ratio
FROM region_metrics r
CROSS JOIN global_mean g
WHERE g.global_avg_amount IS NOT NULL
